faces.name: Replenish
faces.oracleText: Return all enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. (Auras with nothing to enchant remain in your graveyard.)

faces.name: Replicating Ring
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on this artifact. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."

faces.name: Replicating Terror
faces.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature. For each creature sacrificed this way, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard.

faces.name: Replication Specialist
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever a nontoken artifact you control enters, you may pay {1}{U}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that artifact.

faces.name: Replication Technique
faces.oracleText:
Demonstrate (When you cast this spell, you may copy it. If you do, choose an opponent to also copy it. Players may choose new targets for their copies.)
Create a token that's a copy of target permanent you control.

faces.name: Replicator
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
{2}, {T}: Create a tapped token that's a copy of target token you control.
